name: ignite-medical/ci-otp-authenticator
description: Managed external dependencies for the ci-otp-authenticator plugin (replaces the hard-copied libraries/ SDK trees).

imt-dependency-notes._status: ALL WIRED 2026-06-30. twilio, alibabacloud, bandwidth are Composer-managed; the three gateways load vendor/autoload.php and the entire vendored libraries/ tree was deleted.
imt-dependency-notes.twilio/sdk: WIRED. Replaced vendored libraries/twilio (6.9.2, custom SplClassLoader) with 6.44.x — same Twilio\Rest\Client API. class-otpa-twilio-gateway.php loads vendor/autoload.php. (v8 is a BREAKING major; stayed on v6.)
imt-dependency-notes.alibabacloud/sdk: WIRED. Replaced vendored libraries/alibaba with alibabacloud/sdk ^1.8 (same AlibabaCloud\Client API). class-otpa-alibaba-cloud-sms-gateway.php loads vendor/autoload.php.
imt-dependency-notes.bandwidth/sdk: WIRED. Replaced vendored libraries/bandwidth (2.14) with v13. v13 keeps the same BandwidthLib API (Configuration/BandwidthClient/Messaging, incl. getMessages), so class-otpa-bandwidth-sms-gateway.php just loads vendor/autoload.php — no API rewrite. Note: v13 still bundles unirest; managed version bump, not an escape from that transitive dep.
